model_memory.operand_banks: Two ping-pong B banks; A and INT32 partials share vector scratch.
model_memory.weight_layout: Prepacked 2048-output-column tiles; tied embedding gathered from same storage.
model_memory.scheduling: Serial operators; callback-gated ping-pong DMA overlaps array computation; A and C partials retained in scratch.
model_memory.traffic: Two streaming passes fuse V dequant/max/requant and remove FP32/layout HBM intermediates; INT8 V output and scales still stored in HBM.
model_memory.compute: Native WS/OS demand counts with staged operands; vector passes, SRAM bandwidth and reduction/SFU latency are modeled.

required_integration: Synchronous SRAM operand/partial-sum adapters and arbitration
HBM DMA with 2048 outstanding requests and 32 pseudochannel interfaces
FP32 vector/SFU and two-pass cache conversion with original rounding
Full operator sequencer, clock-domain crossing and FPGA/ASIC implementation
